query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> AND script_hash IN ('0291ae7aebaf064b785542093c2b13169effb34462301e68d4b44f43', '3babcffc6102ec25ced40e1a24fba20371925c46f0299b2b9456360e', 'd55e332cd46d2abfe24dfa0558c2dedd0114d00424352eb807aac137')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
